# Whale Scientific Calculator
An all-in-one scientific calculator that lives in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar. It opens as a full o
cean-lit panel and closes back to the conversation. Every calculation runs locally in the browser —
**zero tokens, zero network requests, no model calls**.
## Features
| Tab | What it does |
| Scientific | Safe recursive-descent parser (no `eval`), implicit multiplication, `sin/cos/tan/asin
/acos/atan/ln/log/sqrt/cbrt/abs/exp`, factorial, postfix percent, `π`, `e`, `φ`, `Ans`, degree/radia

n mode, keyboard input, persistent history. |
| Graph | Plot any function of `x` over a configurable

window, with automatically located roots. |
| Matrix | Parse `1 2; 3 4`, then add, multiply, transp

ose, invert or take a determinant. |
| Statistics | Count, sum, mean, median, mode, variance, standa

rd deviation, quartiles, and least-squares linear regression. |
| Units | Length, mass, time, area,

volume, speed, energy, power, pressure, data and temperature conversions. |
| Programmer | Hex / dec
imal / octal / binary views of a 64-bit two's-complement integer, bit display, bitwise operations. |
The **local assistant** panel understands natural-language requests and shows the answer plus its st
eps, entirely offline:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Chinese phrasings work too: `解方程 x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0`, `求导 x^3 - 3x at 2`, `积分 sin(x) from 0 to 3.14`,
sings work too: `解方程 x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0`, `求导 x^3 - 3x at 2`, `积分 sin(x) from 0 to 3.14`, `分解质因数 360`.
The interface is a dark ocean scene with an animated whale, drifting light rays and rising bubbles.
English and Chinese follow the Harness locale automatically.

Recommended — install from the repository:

Or from npm once published:

In the official desktop app, open **Plugins → Add plugin** and paste the same spec.
After installing, **restart DeepSeek Harness** so the client module graph is rebuilt, then click the
whale icon in the left sidebar. The `✕` button, or selecting Conversation, returns to the chat.
## Requirements
- DeepSeek Harness with the `sidebar.panellist` and `main` slots (the sidebar plugin-entry API intro

duced with the 0.2 series).
- No host-side dependencies: the host entry is empty and everything rend

ers in the Web client.
- Windows, macOS and Linux — the plugin is pure ES2020 JavaScript, SVG and CS

s in the Web client.
- Windows, macOS and Linux — the plugin is pure ES2020 JavaScript, SVG and CSS.

## Privacy
The plugin makes **no network requests** and collects nothing. Calculator history is stored in the b
rowser's `localStorage` under `whale-calc:history:v1` and can be cleared from the calculator card.
